title: Wideband Two-Ray Channel
text: 宽带两射线信道环境，输入 5 路、输出 1 路；按 {Ground reflection coefficient} 指定地面反射系数；{Signal propagation speed (m/s)} 指定信号传播速度 physconst、{Signal carrier frequency (Hz)} 指定信号载频 300e6、{Number of subbands} 指定处理子带数、{Specify atmospheric parameters} 启用大气衰减模型、{Temperature (degrees Celsius)} 指定环境温度、{Dry air pressure (Pa)} 指定大气干空气压力 101.325e3、{Water vapour density (g/m^3)} 指定大气水蒸气密度、{Liquid water density (g/m^3)} 指定液态水密度、{Rain rate (mm/hr)} 指定降雨率、{Inherit sample rate} 指定从上游模块继承采样率、{Sample rate (Hz)} 指定信号采样率 1e6、{Combine two rays at output} 指定在输出中组合两条射线、{Maximum one-way propagation distance (m)} 指定最大单向传播距离 10.0e3、{Simulate using} 指定模块仿真方法 Interpreted，按实例取值。

ports.name: X
ports.summary: 宽带输入信号 M -by- N complex-valued matrix | M -by- 2N complex-valued matrix

ports.name: Pos1
ports.summary: 信号源位置 3-by-1 real-valued column vector | 3-by- N real-valued matrix

ports.name: Pos2
ports.summary: 信号目的地的位置 3-by-1 real-valued column vector | 3-by- N real-valued matrix

ports.name: Vel1
ports.summary: 信号原点的速度 3-by-1 real-valued column vector | 3-by- N real-valued matrix

ports.name: Vel2
ports.summary: 信号目的地的速度 3-by-1 real-valued column vector | 3-by- N real-valued matrix

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: 传播信号 M -by- N complex-valued matrix | M -by- 2N complex-valued matrix

params.name: Signal propagation speed (m/s)
params.values: 信号传播速度 physconst(’LightSpeed’) (default) | real-valued positive scalar

params.name: Signal carrier frequency (Hz)
params.values: 信号载频 300e6 (default) | positive real-valued scalar

params.name: Specify atmospheric parameters
params.values: 启用大气衰减模型 off (default) | on

params.name: Dry air pressure (Pa)
params.values: 大气干空气压力 101.325e3 (default) | positive real-valued scalar

params.name: Water vapour density (g/m^3)
params.values: 大气水蒸气密度 7.5 (default) | positive real-valued scalar

params.name: Liquid water density (g/m^3)
params.values: 液态水密度 0.0 (default) | nonnegative real-valued scalar

params.name: Inherit sample rate
params.values: 从上游模块继承采样率 on (default) | off

params.name: Sample rate (Hz)
params.values: 信号采样率 1e6 (default) | positive real-valued scalar

params.name: Ground reflection coefficient
params.values: 地面反射系数 -1 (default) | complex-valued scalar | complex-valued 1-by- N row vector

params.name: Combine two rays at output
params.values: 在输出中组合两条射线的选项 on (default) | off

params.name: Maximum one-way propagation distance (m)
params.values: 最大单向传播距离 10.0e3 (default) | positive real-valued scalar

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 模块仿真方法 Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
